title: Turn Dock auto-hiding on or off in System Settings

setup.why: Keep the Mac's own value for teardown, then set the opposite of the asked state and restart the Dock so it shows.

instruction: Using System Settings, turn {{mode.say}} automatically hiding and showing the Dock.

checks.why: com.apple.dock autohide, which the "Automatically hide and show the Dock" switch of System Settings › Desktop & Dock writes, is the asked state (1 on, 0 off).

argv: if application id "com.apple.systempreferences" is running then

teardown.why: Put back the Mac's own value and restart the Dock.

oracle.why: Write the asked state and restart the Dock, as the switch does.

argv: defaults write com.apple.dock autohide -bool {{mode.set}} && killall Dock
